nodes.name: CommandsHexa.ts
nodes.summary: Hexagon entry point for the commands domain: wires repositories, services and the CommandsAdapter, exposing the ICommandsPort to other hexagons.

nodes.name: CommandsHexa
nodes.summary: Hexa class extending BaseHexa that constructs repositories/services/adapter and exposes the commands port.

nodes.name: CommandsAdapter.ts
nodes.summary: Adapter implementing ICommandsPort that delegates to command use cases and services, and builds the deploy-commands delayed job once ports are injected.

nodes.name: CommandsAdapter
nodes.summary: Implements ICommandsPort and IBaseAdapter, routing every command operation to use cases or services and wiring delayed jobs.

nodes.name: DeployCommandsDelayedJob.ts
nodes.summary: BullMQ-backed delayed job that deploys command versions to a git repository through the deployment port and dispatches completion callbacks.

nodes.name: DeployCommandsDelayedJob
nodes.summary: Extends AbstractAIDelayedJob to run command deployments via IDeploymentPort with failure handling and callbacks.

nodes.name: CommandService.ts
nodes.summary: Domain service for command CRUD: creation, slug lookup, space listing and counts, updates, soft/hard deletion, duplication and move tracking.

nodes.name: CommandService
nodes.summary: Service encapsulating command persistence operations over ICommandRepository and ICommandVersionRepository.

nodes.name: CommandVersionService.ts
nodes.summary: Domain service managing command versions: adding versions, listing history, fetching latest/by-id versions and deleting versions for a command.

nodes.name: CommandVersionService
nodes.summary: Service encapsulating command version persistence and queries.

nodes.name: CommandsServices.ts
nodes.summary: Aggregator that instantiates CommandService and CommandVersionService from the commands repositories.

nodes.name: CommandsServices
nodes.summary: Holder giving access to CommandService and CommandVersionService instances.

nodes.name: CaptureCommandUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Space-member use case that captures a new command: resolves a unique sanitized slug, assembles content, persists the command and its first version.

nodes.name: CaptureCommandUseCase
nodes.summary: Creates a command with unique slug and initial version for a space member.

nodes.name: DeleteCommandUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Space-member use case that soft-deletes a command after verifying space access and emits the related domain event.

nodes.name: DeleteCommandUseCase
nodes.summary: Deletes a command for a space member after access validation.

nodes.name: DeleteCommandsBatchUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Use case deleting multiple commands by delegating each to DeleteCommandUseCase.

nodes.name: DeleteCommandsBatchUseCase
nodes.summary: Deletes a list of commands by invoking DeleteCommandUseCase per id.

nodes.name: FindCommandBySlugUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Use case looking up a command by slug within an organization via CommandService.

nodes.name: FindCommandBySlugUseCase
nodes.summary: Finds a command by slug and organization.

nodes.name: GetCommandByIdUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Space-member use case returning a command by id, ensuring it belongs to the requested space.

nodes.name: GetCommandByIdUseCase
nodes.summary: Returns a command by id scoped to an accessible space.

nodes.name: GetCommandVersionUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Use case retrieving a specific version of a command via CommandVersionService.

nodes.name: GetCommandVersionUseCase
nodes.summary: Returns a specific command version.

nodes.name: ListCommandVersionsUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Use case listing all versions of a command via CommandVersionService.

nodes.name: ListCommandVersionsUseCase
nodes.summary: Lists version history of a command.

nodes.name: ListCommandsBySpaceUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Space-member use case listing the commands of a space after access checks.

nodes.name: ListCommandsBySpaceUseCase
nodes.summary: Lists commands within a space for its members.

nodes.name: UpdateCommandFromUIUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Space-member use case updating a command from the web UI, creating a new command version and emitting an update event.

nodes.name: UpdateCommandFromUIUseCase
nodes.summary: Updates a command from the UI, creating a new version.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting all commands domain error classes (not found, slug conflict, space access, queue and port errors).

nodes.name: DeployCommands.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions for the deploy-commands job input (org, git repo, version ids, target paths) and output counts.

nodes.name: ICommandsDelayedJobs.ts
nodes.summary: Interface listing the commands domain delayed jobs, namely the deploy-commands job.

nodes.name: ICommandRepository.ts
nodes.summary: Repository port for commands, extending IRepository with slug, user, space lookups, space counts and move marking.

nodes.name: ICommandVersionRepository.ts
nodes.summary: Repository port for command versions with lookups by command, latest versions, ids and command+version.

nodes.name: ICommandsRepositories.ts
nodes.summary: Interface aggregating access to the command and command version repositories.

nodes.name: DeployCommandsJobFactory.ts
nodes.summary: Job factory creating the BullMQ queue and DeployCommandsDelayedJob for command deployments.

nodes.name: DeployCommandsJobFactory
nodes.summary: IJobFactory implementation creating the deploy-commands queue and delayed job.

nodes.name: CommandRepository.ts
nodes.summary: TypeORM repository for commands implementing slug/user/space queries, per-space counts and marking commands as moved.

nodes.name: CommandRepository
nodes.summary: AbstractRepository subclass implementing ICommandRepository with TypeORM queries.

nodes.name: CommandVersionRepository.ts
nodes.summary: TypeORM repository for command versions with queries for history, latest versions per command and space-scoped version lookup.

nodes.name: CommandVersionRepository
nodes.summary: AbstractRepository subclass implementing ICommandVersionRepository with TypeORM queries.

nodes.name: CommandsRepositories.ts
nodes.summary: Concrete ICommandsRepositories building TypeORM-backed command and command version repositories from a DataSource.

nodes.name: CommandsRepositories
nodes.summary: Implements ICommandsRepositories by instantiating both TypeORM repositories.

nodes.name: CommandSchema.ts
nodes.summary: TypeORM EntitySchema for the commands table with timestamps, soft delete, space/org relations and git commit link.

nodes.name: CommandVersionSchema.ts
nodes.summary: TypeORM EntitySchema for the command_versions table storing versioned command content linked to commands and git commits.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel exporting the command TypeORM schemas and the commandsSchemas array for DataSource registration.
